stage.name: Paddy Field 9-7
stage.description:
These hundred mu of fragrant fields and paddies are also the hope of farmers who dream of a future without famine. Vermin encroach once more, and blight has begun to pollute the crops. We ask Rhodes Island for aid in protecting the harvests of these hard-working farmers!
<Special Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Farmland> Operators on Farmland recover HP or take damage based on Blight level.

Elite.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Jia

enemyConfigurations.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Jia
Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.name: Originium Slug β
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than an Originium Slug α. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

expelled_filth.name: Expelled Filth
expelled_filth.flavourText: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a failed harvest. They carry a wide range of crop-killing Blights, and pose a tremendous risk to agricultural yields.
abilities: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

filth.name: Filth
filth.flavourText: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a poor harvest. They carry a crop-killing Blight, and pose a great risk to agricultural yields.
abilities: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

banished_consumption.name: Banished Consumption
banished_consumption.flavourText: A fabric construct that corrodes plants, capable of spraying highly hazardous Blight from a distance. Even well-protected crops on agricultural plates are at risk.
abilities: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

fieldmus.name: Fieldmus
fieldmus.flavourText: The fieldmus is the farmer's sworn enemy, as well as a living page from the annals of Terra's agricultural history. They have adapted to modern farming techniques, and even Throttle Valves cannot escape their destructive tendencies.
abilities: Attacks surrounding Throttle Valves
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

consumption.name: Consumption
consumption.flavourText: A fabric construct that contaminates plants, capable of spraying Blight from a distance. Even crops on agricultural plates are at risk.
abilities: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

hard_snouted_fieldmus.name: Hard-Snouted Fieldmus
hard_snouted_fieldmus.flavourText: The fieldmus is the farmer's sworn enemy, as well as a living page from the annals of Terra's agricultural history. They have fully adapted to modern farming techniques, and even the most advanced Throttle Valves cannot escape their destructive tendencies.
abilities: Attacks surrounding Throttle Valves
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

accursed_scum.name: Accursed Scum
accursed_scum.flavourText: A gargantuan fabric construct that uses its huge mass and nigh-impenetrable skin to wreak havoc across the paddies, loathed by farmers.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

scum.name: Scum
scum.flavourText: A large fabric construct that uses its huge mass and thick skin to run rampant across the paddies, detested by farmers.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

renounced_blemish.name: Renounced Blemish
renounced_blemish.flavourText: A fabric construct that ruthlessly spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will instantly become a farmer's worst nightmare.
abilities: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

blemish.name: Blemish
blemish.flavourText: A fabric construct that spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will become a hotbed of blight in less than half a day.
abilities: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

basal_miasma.name: Basal Miasma
basal_miasma.flavourText: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become very aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise the utmost caution.
abilities: Rebirth
Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

fieldmus_heistmaster.name: Fieldmus Heistmaster
fieldmus_heistmaster.flavourText: The thing with fieldmus is that not only do they dismantle farm equipment, they also leave no loose parts behind. Who knows, maybe they'll be able to build a nomadic city one day.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over
When defeated, grants a deployable unit

miasma.name: Miasma
miasma.flavourText: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise caution.
abilities: Rebirth
Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

sky_pole_jia.name: Sky Pole - Jia
sky_pole_jia.flavourText: Structural pillar-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Jia. Capable of monitoring soil conditions, water source quality, and pest and Blight status in real time; during emergency situations, can release the corresponding Sky Pole Model Yi.
abilities: Starts battle as a friendly unit, monitors the paddy's Blight level
Wakes up when the Blight level in the current paddy exceeds a certain threshold
Gradually loses HP. For every certain percentage of HP lost, releases a certain number of Sky Pole - Yi

out_of_control_sky_pole_jia.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Jia
out_of_control_sky_pole_jia.flavourText: Structural pillar-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Jia. Originally capable of monitoring soil conditions, water source quality, and pest and Blight status in real time; during emergency situations, can release the corresponding Sky Pole Model Yi. However, it has now gone out of control.
abilities: Starts battle as a friendly unit, monitors the paddy's Blight level
Wakes up when the Blight level in the current paddy exceeds a certain threshold
Gradually loses HP. For every certain percentage of HP lost, releases a certain number of Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi
